title: The Mahjong Tradition
text:
Traditions connect us. They create reasons to gather, stories to share, and bonds that span generations. For over a century, Mahjong has been one of those powerful traditions.
Born in China in the late 1800s, Mahjong quickly spread from home to home, region to region. More than just a game, it became a way for families, neighbors, and friends to connect.
When Mahjong arrived in America in the 1920s, it found new communities while honoring its roots. Asian American families embraced it as a tie to heritage. Jewish women made it a cornerstone of friendship, passing the tradition from mothers to daughters. Across neighborhoods and living rooms, it carried the same spirit of gathering and joy that defined it from the beginning.
Today, Mahjong continues to bring people together for connection, laughter, and bonds that outlast any single evening at the table.

title: Our Story
text:
We’re Amanda and Lucy, and we believe you can have a bit of magic in everyday life.
We started playing Mahjong together and loved everything about it–the strategy, the socializing, and those perfect moments when everything clicks. But we also shared something else: a love for immersive experiences where every single detail has been thoughtfully crafted to transport you somewhere extraordinary.
That’s when we realized we wanted to create Mahjong sets the same way the most magical places on earth create their experiences. We pay extra attention to every detail: the width of the tiles and how they feel in your hands, the color choices, the little easter eggs and surprises tucked into every set. We want to give you that same feeling you get when you step into a world where wonder is around every corner, except this magic happens right in your living room.

Our mission is simple:
 To craft luxury Mahjong sets and accessories with artistry and care
 To honor the tradition and community that make Mahjong so meaningful
 To inspire moments of laughter, beauty, joy, and magic

For us, it isn’t just about Mahjong. It’s about bringing joy into your life in as many ways as possible.
Amanda & Lucy
